findings: Covers every section in book order: software development, SDLC and its six stages, functional and non-functional requirements, frameworks, process models (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, Lean, DevOps), project planning, timelines, cost estimation, risk management, quality assurance, UML and its four diagrams, the four design patterns, debugging, the four testing levels and the software development tools. None repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: Lean principle 4 (incremental features), UML inheritance arrowhead, sequence-diagram arrows from User to box, 2 QA testers, contingency fund PKR 1,804,000 and total PKR 19,844,000. The 1970 Royce 'Waterfall' sentence and the 1947 moth story are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
